listings.thesis: Highest-priority alpha screen: strong AI/CPO/advanced-packaging theme plus smaller or less fully penetrated market-cap base.

priorCase.rankRationale: New June 11 binding InP supply deal (~$25.4M through 2027) is fresh validation of the CPO/optical-substrate bottleneck thesis, a genuine fundamental positive on this high-priority alpha screen. Tempered upgrade only: revenue is still gated by Chinese export permits and the name already ran +377% YTD.
